title: Llama 3.3 Release
summary: Meta released Llama 3.3 70B Instruct on December 6, 2024. Meta's official model card records that release date and identifies Llama 3.3 as a multilingual, text-only model.
significance: A dated release milestone in the Llama model family for the 70B Llama 3.3 model.

verification.note: Meta's official Llama 3.3 model card records the 70B Instruct model release date as December 6, 2024. Meta's official Llama 3.3 Community License independently states the Llama 3.3 version release date as December 6, 2024. A later Meta retrospective confirms that Llama 3.3 70B was released in 2024 and describes it as a text-only model.
